---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: us-letter
    margin:
      x: 0.34in
      top: 0.30in
      # The colophon lives in the bottom margin. At 0.30in it landed about 0.06in
      # from the paper edge, inside the unprintable margin of most printers.
      bottom: 0.55in
    fontsize: 10pt
    mainfont: "PT Sans Caption"
    include-in-header: _panels.typ
    keep-typ: false
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}

  "the project policy that loaded, if any",
  "the rule: fix the root cause, at file:line",
  "long runs already going, marked as not yours",
  "running containers and detached screens",
  "the branch, and changes that predate the session",
  "submodule pointers that have drifted"
)

## Skill names, so the panel can set them in the code face. Every one is a real
## skill: the first five are third-party (superpowers, r-lib, quarto), the last is
## the one here that replaces superpowers' finishing-a-development-branch.
companions <- list(
  "plan" = "brainstorming, writing-plans",
  "implement" = "r-package-development, quarto-authoring",
  "debug" = "systematic-debugging",
  "verify" = "verification-before-completion",
  "review" = "receiving-code-review",
  "release" = "package-change-workflow"
)

own_hook <- list(
  "identity" = "resolve the repo through git, not the working directory",
  "deny" = "only where a safe alternative exists to take",
  "ask" = "for what is fine once a person has looked",
  "context" = "to inform without blocking a risky command"
)

## -- emitting Typst ------------------------------------------------------
typ_str <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\", "\\\\", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("\"", "\\\"", x, fixed = TRUE)
  paste0("\"", x, "\"")
}

## Raw Typst has to be fenced, or pandoc renders the code as prose.
emit <- function(...) {
  cat("```{=typst}\n")
  cat(paste0(c(...), collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("```\n")
}

n_of <- function(plugin, kind) sum(inv$plugin == plugin & inv$kind == kind)

## Every panel body is ONE grid, so names align down the whole panel instead of
## restarting at each group. Subheads span both columns.
panel_body <- function(cells) paste0("#rowsg(", paste(cells, collapse = ", "), ")")

head_cell <- function(title, count = NULL) {
  paste0(
    "span2(subhead(", typ_str(title),
    if (is.null(count)) "" else paste0(", count: ", typ_str(count)), "))"
  )
}

pair_cells <- function(x, mono_left = TRUE) {
  vapply(names(x), function(k) {
    left <- if (mono_left) paste0("mono(", typ_str(k), ")") else paste0("note(", typ_str(k), ")")
    paste0(left, ", note(", typ_str(x[[k]]), ")")
  }, character(1L))
}

bullet_cells <- function(x) paste0("dot, note(", typ_str(x), ")")

## Bundle contents read better without the repeated r- and r-bundle- prefixes.
short_deps <- function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(x, ", ", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  paste(sub("^r-", "", sub("^r-bundle-", "", parts)), collapse = ", ")
}

bundle_cells <- function() {
  rows <- inv[inv$kind == "bundle", ]
  rows <- rows[order(grepl("r-bundle-", rows$deps), rows$name), ]
  cells <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
    paste0(
      "mono(", typ_str(rows$name[i]), "), ",
      "note(", typ_str(labels[[rows$id[i]]]), ") + linebreak() + ",
      "subnote(", typ_str(short_deps(rows$deps[i])), ")"
    )
  }, character(1L))
  ## a spacer row between bundles: the contents line wraps, and without this it
  ## reads as belonging to the name below it
  utils::head(as.vector(rbind(cells, "[], []")), -1L)
}

skill_cells <- function(plugin) {
  rows <- inv[inv$plugin == plugin & inv$kind == "skill", ]
  rows <- rows[order(rows$name), ]
  c(
    head_cell(plugin, nrow(rows)),
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
      nm <- if (rows$slash_only[i]) paste0("/", rows$name[i]) else rows$name[i]
      paste0(
        "mono(", typ_str(nm), ")", if (rows$scoped[i]) " + scoped" else "",
        ", note(", typ_str(labels[[rows$id[i]]]), ")"
      )
    }, character(1L))
  )
}

hook_cells <- function(plugin, event, matcher, title) {
  rows <- inv[inv$plugin == plugin & inv$kind == "hook" & inv$event == event, ]
  rows <- if (is.na(matcher)) {
    rows[is.na(rows$matcher), ]
  } else {
    rows[!is.na(rows$matcher) & rows$matcher == matcher, ]
  }
  rows <- rows[order(rows$name), ]
  c(
    head_cell(title, nrow(rows)),
    vapply(seq_len(nrow(rows)), function(i) {
      paste0(
        "mono(", typ_str(sub("\\.sh$", "", rows$name[i])), "), ",
        "note(", typ_str(labels[[rows$id[i]]]), ")"
      )
    }, character(1L))
  )
}

```{r}
#| label: front
#| output: asis
n_skill <- sum(inv$kind == "skill")
n_hook <- length(unique(inv$id[inv$kind == "hook"]))
n_agent <- sum(inv$kind == "agent")
n_bundle <- sum(inv$kind == "bundle")

## Core first, then the domains in rough order of how often they apply.
skill_order <- c("r-project-core", "r-targets", "r-geospatial", "r-package-dev",
                 "r-reporting", "r-spades", "r-landis-ii", "r-code-review")
stopifnot(setequal(skill_order, unique(inv$plugin[inv$kind == "skill"])))

plugin_counts <- function(p) {
  paste0(
    n_of(p, "skill"), " / ",
    length(unique(inv$id[inv$plugin == p & inv$kind == "hook"])), " / ",
    n_of(p, "agent")
  )
}

emit(
  "#show: doc => sheet-typography(colophon-left: ",
  typ_str(paste0(
    mk$name, " v", mk$version, "   |   Copyright (c) ", lic$year, " ", lic$holder,
    "   |   ", lic$spdx, " licence"
  )),
  ", colophon-right: ", typ_str(repo), ", doc)"
)
emit(
  "#titlebar(", typ_str(mk$name), ", ",
  typ_str("for R research software"), ", ",
  typ_str(paste0(
    "v", mk$version, "  |  ", length(content_plugins), " plugins, ", n_bundle,
    " bundles   |   ", n_skill, " skills   |   ", n_hook, " hooks   |   ", n_agent, " agents"
  )), ")"
)

## The left column is the setup path, read top to bottom and ending in the commands;
## the right column is the reference. That keeps the skills index whole rather than
## splitting it across the fold, and puts install inside the first column a reader
## scans rather than halfway down the second.
col_a <- c(
  "#panel(\"plugins\", count: \"skills / hooks / subagents\")[",
  paste0("#rows3(", paste(vapply(names(plugin_for), function(p) {
    paste0(
      "mono(", typ_str(p), "), note(", typ_str(plugin_for[[p]]), "), ",
      "note(", typ_str(plugin_counts(p)), ")"
    )
  }, character(1L)), collapse = ", "), ")"),
  "]",
  paste0("#panel(\"bundles: research, plus one per framework\", count: \"", n_bundle, "\")["),
  panel_body(bundle_cells()),
  "]",
  "#panel(\"or enable plugins directly\")[",
  panel_body(pair_cells(by_project, mono_left = FALSE)),
  "]",
  "#panel(\"install: add BOTH marketplaces\")[",
  "#subhead(\"1. add the marketplaces\")",
  "#codeline(\"/plugin marketplace add FOR-CAST/ai_workflows\")",
  unlist(lapply(external_marketplaces, function(repo) {
    paste0("#codeline(", typ_str(paste0("/plugin marketplace add ", repo)), ")")
  })),
  paste0("#notepara[#emph[Nothing auto-adds another marketplace.] r-package-dev depends ",
         "on #raw(\"r-lib@posit-dev-skills\"): add both first, in either order, or it ",
         "and every bundle above it report the dependency missing.]"),
  "#subhead(\"2. enable a bundle, then set policy\")",
  "#codeline(\"/plugin install r-bundle-research@ai-workflows\")",
  "#codeline(\"/r-project-core:project-policy\")",
  "#subhead(\"3. share the setup with the project\")",
  paste0("#notepara[#raw(\".claude/settings.json\") carries #raw(\"extraKnownMarketplaces\") ",
         "and #raw(\"enabledPlugins\"); declare the posit marketplace there too, so the ",
         "dependency resolves. The #raw(\"claude plugin\") CLI does not read project ",
         "settings: install from a session, once the folder is trusted.]"),
  "]",
  "#panel(\"uninstall, or just turn it off\")[",
  "#subhead(\"stop it, remove it, or forget the source\")",
  "#codeline(\"/plugin disable r-package-dev@ai-workflows\")",
  "#codeline(\"/plugin uninstall r-bundle-research@ai-workflows\")",
  "#codeline(\"/plugin prune\")",
  "#codeline(\"/plugin marketplace remove ai-workflows\")",
  paste0("#notepara[#raw(\"disable\") keeps a plugin installed but inert. ",
         "#raw(\"uninstall\") removes it, and #raw(\"prune\") then drops the dependencies ",
         "it pulled in that nothing else needs, which is worth running after removing ",
         "a bundle.]"),
  "#subhead(\"or switch off one piece\")",
  paste0("#notepara[One hook: drop its entry from that plugin\'s #raw(\"hooks/hooks.json\"). ",
         "All of them: #raw(\"disableAllHooks\") in settings. One policy rule: remove its ",
         "key from #raw(\"r-project-policy.json\").]"),
  "]"
)

col_b <- c(
  "#panel(\"three kinds of tooling\")[",
  panel_body(pair_cells(kinds)),
  "]",
  paste0("#panel(\"skills: when to reach for them\", count: \"", n_skill, "\")["),
  panel_body(unlist(lapply(skill_order, skill_cells))),
  "]",
  paste0("#panel(\"review subagents\", count: \"", n_agent, ", read-only\")["),
  panel_body(vapply(
    inv$id[inv$kind == "agent"],
    function(id) {
      paste0("mono(", typ_str(sub("^.*/", "", id)), "), note(", typ_str(labels[[id]]), ")")
    },
    character(1L)
  )),
  "]",
  "#panel(\"companions, by workflow stage\")[",
  panel_body(vapply(names(companions), function(k) {
    paste0("stage(", typ_str(k), "), mono(", typ_str(companions[[k]]), ")")
  }, character(1L))),
  "#v(2pt)",
  paste0("#notepara[#emph[Which third-party skills to pair with these, and which to ",
         "avoid, is in docs/third-party.md.]]"),
  "]",
  paste0("#footnote-strip[#scoped = paths-scoped: the skill wakes only on matching files. ",
         "/name = slash command only, never auto-invoked. Plugin counts are ",
         "skills / hooks / subagents.]")
)

emit("#cols2([", paste(col_a, collapse = "\n"), "], [", paste(col_b, collapse = "\n"), "])")
```

```{r}
#| label: back

emit("#pagebreak()")
emit(
  "#titlebar(", typ_str("what stops you"), ", ",

)

n_reg_core <- sum(inv$kind == "hook" & inv$plugin == "r-project-core")
n_reg_pkg <- sum(inv$kind == "hook" & inv$plugin == "r-package-dev")

col_a <- c(
  paste0("#panel(\"hooks: r-project-core\", count: \"", n_reg_core, " registrations\")["),
  panel_body(c(
    hook_cells("r-project-core", "SessionStart", NA, "SessionStart"),
    hook_cells("r-project-core", "PreToolUse", "Bash", "PreToolUse / Bash"),
    hook_cells("r-project-core", "PreToolUse", "Edit|Write|NotebookEdit",
               "PreToolUse / Edit, Write, Notebook"),
    hook_cells("r-project-core", "PreToolUse", "mcp__.*", "PreToolUse / MCP tools"),
    hook_cells("r-project-core", "PostToolUse", "Edit|Write", "PostToolUse / Edit, Write")
  )),
  "]",
  paste0("#panel(\"hooks: r-package-dev\", count: \"", n_reg_pkg, " registrations\")["),
  panel_body(c(
    hook_cells("r-package-dev", "PreToolUse", "Edit|Write", "PreToolUse / Edit, Write"),
    hook_cells("r-package-dev", "PostToolUse", "Edit|Write", "PostToolUse / Edit, Write"),
    hook_cells("r-package-dev", "Stop", NA, "Stop")
  )),
  "]",
  paste0("#panel(\"project policy\", count: \"", length(policy_keys), " keys\")["),
  paste0("#notepara[#emph[.claude/r-project-policy.json: every rule is off until the repo ",
         "opts in. Generate one with /r-project-core:project-policy.]]"),
  "#v(3.5pt)",
  panel_body(pair_cells(as.list(policy_effect))),
  "]"
)

col_b <- c(
  "#panel(\"a guard fired, do this instead\")[",
  vapply(guards, function(g) {
    paste0("#guardrow(", typ_str(g[1]), ", ", typ_str(g[2]), ")")
  }, character(1L)),
  "]",
  "#panel(\"the session report\", count: \"SessionStart\")[",
  panel_body(bullet_cells(session_report)),
  "]",
  "#panel(\"writing your own hook\")[",
  panel_body(pair_cells(own_hook, mono_left = FALSE)),
  "]",
  paste0("#footnote-strip[A deny cannot be approved from the permission prompt; an ask can. ",
         "If a guard fires when it should not, the fix is almost always a policy value ",
         "rather than a code change.]")
)

emit("#cols2([", paste(col_a, collapse = "\n"), "], [", paste(col_b, collapse = "\n"), "])")
